what_it_is.prose: Nibe Limited (formerly Kavita Fabrics Limited) is an India-based defence and aerospace manufacturing company incorporated on 18 October 2005 as a private textile company in Gujarat, and renamed Nibe Limited in July 2020 after pivoting to defence and aerospace manufacturing. Headquartered at Plot No. E-2/2, Phase III MIDC Industrial Area, Nanekarwadi CT, Chakan, Pune (Maharashtra), Nibe is engaged in fabrication and machining of components used in the defence sector. Products include: jet deflectors (essential components used in missile systems and aircraft), MRSAM cassettes, Modular Bridges, Short Span Bridges, logistical equipment. Nibe has established a new subsidiary Nibe Space Private Limited (76% stake, 2024) for research in space/launch technologies. Nibe secured a USD 17.52 million export order from an Israeli technology firm for rocket launchers (May 2025). The company is also developing small arms and aerospace systems through Nibe Defence and Aerospace Limited subsidiary. Total employees ~349.
